tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: App background. Warm violet-ink, not pure black — the choice that anchors the brand.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards and panels resting on the canvas.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Insets, inputs, hover fills, muted chips.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: Toasts, popovers, dragged items — above the surface.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline borders between surfaces.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Emphasised borders, dividers, control outlines.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on canvas, surface and surface-2 (4.5:1+ in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary text and body copy on surface.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: labels, captions, meta. Not for body copy.

tokens.name: violet
tokens.usage: Primary action and the AI / copilot accent. Fill for primary buttons.

tokens.name: violet-soft
tokens.usage: Violet text and icons on dark/tinted fills.

tokens.name: violet-ghost
tokens.usage: Violet tint fill behind AI/copilot elements and active nav.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Reserved accent for match / success / achievement — the 'good fortune' payoff. Never general chrome.

tokens.name: gold-soft
tokens.usage: Gold text/icons on dark or tinted fills.

tokens.name: gold-ghost
tokens.usage: Gold tint fill for match moments and the Career plan badge.

tokens.name: match
tokens.usage: Strong match, resolved state, confirmation. High ring values.

tokens.name: match-ghost
tokens.usage: Match/success tint fill; accepted-diff background.

tokens.name: gap
tokens.usage: Missing requirement, at-risk, soft-destructive. Paired with a label, never color alone.

tokens.name: gap-ghost
tokens.usage: Gap/warning tint fill.

tokens.name: page
tokens.usage: The CV paper surface in the editor and preview.

tokens.name: page-ink
tokens.usage: Text on the CV paper. Keeps its own high contrast regardless of app theme.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon gaps, tight insets.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside controls; chip padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Default gap between related elements.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card and panel padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Comfortable card padding; small section gaps.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between cards and blocks.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Section rhythm within a view.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Major vertical separation.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, badges, small controls.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, inner cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and panels.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Hero / spotlight surfaces, the match-ring card.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status pills, suggestion chips, toggles, avatars.

tokens.name: shadow-soft
tokens.usage: Resting cards. Light theme: 0 12px 30px -20px rgba(40,30,80,0.20).

tokens.name: shadow
tokens.usage: CV paper, popovers, dragged items. Light theme: 0 30px 60px -32px rgba(40,30,80,0.28).
